name: stri_trans_isnfc
title: Test whether strings are in NFC

origin.description: Report whether each string is already in NFC.
origin.details: TRUE when the string is already in NFC. A precomposed character is TRUE and the same character written as a base plus a mark is FALSE. An empty string is TRUE. A missing value stays missing.
origin.value: A logical vector of the same length as str.
origin.example:
cat(paste0("stri_trans_isnfc of a followed by a combining acute returns ", stri_trans_isnfc("á"), ".
"))

translation.description: Report whether each string is already in NFC.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list or tuple of those.

translation.details: unicodedata.is_normalized with NFC matches this test. An empty string is True. NA stays NA.
translation.value: True or False, or a list of those values when str is a list or tuple.
translation.example:
from stringi.normalize import stri_trans_isnfc
print(f"stri_trans_isnfc of a followed by a combining acute returns {stri_trans_isnfc('á')}.")
